title: Monster
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Japanese neurosurgeon Kenzo Tenma saves a young boy instead of a politically important mayor. Years later the boy, Johan, is revealed as a manipulative serial killer, and Tenma, now a suspect, hunts him across Germany and Czechoslovakia, uncovering an orphanage's eugenics experiments.
life_message: It holds up that every life has equal worth and that one must take responsibility for one's choices.

content.note: Murders and killings throughout (Wikipedia; AniList Crime 92%, Noir).
Sustained psychological suspense and menace (Wikipedia; genre Thriller, Psychological).
Johan drives people to suicide; abused children from Kinderheim 511 (Wikipedia; AniList Suicide signal).

delivery.evidence: ANN reviewers praise suspense and note 'moments of love and hope'; no reviewer calls it preachy (Wikipedia)
delivery.note: Equal worth of every life is carried by Tenma's choices against Johan and the eugenics behind Kinderheim 511.

winners_losers: Ordinary people who refuse to treat lives as unequal earn sympathy; political power and eugenic ideology are shown as sources of evil.
